# Date badge (right side)
fnt_date = font(26, "Medium")
date_text = "Apr 9 – 15, 2026"
dw = text_width(draw, date_text, fnt_date)
date_x = W - MARGIN - dw - 40
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (date_x, 60, date_x + dw + 40, 108), radius=10, fill=CARD, outline=BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((date_x + 20, 70), date_text, fill=AMBER, font=fnt_date)

# Source line
fnt_src = font(22, "Regular")
draw.text((title_x, 195), "Source: star-history.com  ·  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=fnt_src)

y = title_h + 30

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# STATS BANNER (4 metric cards)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
stat_h = 210
stat_w = (CONTENT_W - 30) // 4
stat_gap = 10

fnt_stat_num = mono_font(68, "Bold")
fnt_stat_label = font(22, "Medium")

for i, (num, label, color) in enumerate(METRICS):
    sx = MARGIN + i * (stat_w + stat_gap)
    sy = y

    # Card
    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.08)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (sx, sy, sx + stat_w, sy + stat_h), radius=12, fill=card_bg, outline=blend_color(BG, color, 0.25), width=2)

    # Top accent bar
    draw.rectangle([sx + 12, sy + 2, sx + stat_w - 12, sy + 6], fill=color)

    # Number
    nw = text_width(draw, num, fnt_stat_num)
    draw.text((sx + (stat_w - nw) // 2, sy + 28), num, fill=color, font=fnt_stat_num)

    # Label
    lines = label.split("\n")
    ly = sy + 120
    for line in lines:
        lw = text_width(draw, line, fnt_stat_label)
        draw.text((sx + (stat_w - lw) // 2, ly), line, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_stat_label)
        ly += 30

y += stat_h + 35

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION HEADER: FULL RANKING TABLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
fnt_section = font(36, "Bold", display=True)
draw.text((MARGIN, y), "▸  FULL WEEKLY TOP 20 RANKING", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_section)

# Category legend (right of section header)
fnt_legend = font(20, "Bold")
legend_items = [("Agent", BLUE), ("Claude Code", AMBER), ("Design", PURPLE), ("Utility", GREEN)]
lx = W - MARGIN
for label, color in reversed(legend_items):
    lw = text_width(draw, label, fnt_legend)
    lx -= lw + 30
    draw.rectangle([lx, y + 8, lx + 16, y + 24], fill=color)
    draw.text((lx + 22, y + 5), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_legend)
    lx -= 20

y += 55

# ── Table layout ──
table_x = MARGIN
table_w = CONTENT_W
row_h = 64
header_h = 50

fnt_header = font(22, "Bold")
fnt_rank = mono_font(30, "Bold")
fnt_repo = font(24, "SemiBold")
fnt_stars = mono_font(28, "Bold")
fnt_trend = mono_font(22, "Bold")
fnt_tag = font(17, "Bold")
fnt_new = font(16, "Bold")

# Column widths
col_rank_w = 70
col_trend_w = 55
col_cat_w = 90
col_stars_w = 170
col_repo_w = table_w - col_rank_w - col_trend_w - col_cat_w - col_stars_w

col_rank_x = table_x
col_trend_x = col_rank_x + col_rank_w
col_repo_x = col_trend_x + col_trend_w
col_cat_x = col_repo_x + col_repo_w
col_stars_x = col_cat_x + col_cat_w

# Header row
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (table_x, y, table_x + table_w, y + header_h), radius=8, fill="#1A2332", outline=BORDER, width=1)
header_cols = [
    (col_rank_x + 10, "#"),

]
for hx, htext in header_cols:
    draw.text((hx, y + 12), htext, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_header)
y += header_h + 2

# Data rows
for rank, trend, repo, stars, cat in RANKINGS:
    row_y = y
    cat_color = CATEGORY_COLORS.get(cat, TEXT_DIM)
    cat_label = CATEGORY_LABELS.get(cat, "")

    # Row background
    if rank == 1:

    elif rank == 2:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, BLUE, 0.08)
    elif rank == 3:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, AMBER, 0.08)
    elif rank % 2 == 1:
        bg_color = CARD
    else:
        bg_color = CARD_ALT

    draw.rectangle([table_x, row_y, table_x + table_w, row_y + row_h], fill=bg_color)

    # Left accent bar for top 3
    if rank <= 3:
        accent = {1: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 3: AMBER}[rank]
        draw.rectangle([table_x, row_y, table_x + 5, row_y + row_h], fill=accent)

    # Bottom border
    draw.line([table_x, row_y + row_h - 1, table_x + table_w, row_y + row_h - 1], fill=BORDER, width=1)

    # Rank number
    rank_color = {1: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 3: AMBER}.get(rank, TEXT_SECONDARY)
    draw.text((col_rank_x + 18, row_y + 15), f"{rank}", fill=rank_color, font=fnt_rank)

    # Trend indicator
    trend_x = col_trend_x + 8
    if trend == "▲":
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 19), "▲", fill=GREEN, font=fnt_trend)
    elif trend == "▼":
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 19), "▼", fill=RED, font=fnt_trend)
    elif trend == "N":
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 21), "NEW", fill=CYAN, font=fnt_new)

    # Repository name
    repo_display = repo
    rw = text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo)
    max_repo_w = col_repo_w - 20
    if rw > max_repo_w:
        # Truncate owner part
        parts = repo.split("/")
        owner = parts[0]
        name = "/".join(parts[1:])
        while len(owner) > 2:
            owner = owner[:-1]
            repo_display = owner + "…/" + name
            rw = text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo)
            if rw <= max_repo_w:
                break
        if rw > max_repo_w:
            while rw > max_repo_w and len(repo_display) > 8:
                repo_display = repo_display[:-4] + "…"
                rw = text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo)
    draw.text((col_repo_x + 10, row_y + 18), repo_display, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_repo)

    # Category tag
    tag_y = row_y + (row_h - 26) // 2
    tlw = text_width(draw, cat_label, fnt_tag) + 18
    tag_bg = blend_color(BG, cat_color, 0.15)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (col_cat_x, tag_y, col_cat_x + tlw, tag_y + 26), radius=5, fill=tag_bg, outline=blend_color(BG, cat_color, 0.5), width=1)

    cy = y + (i // 2) * (cluster_h + 15)

    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (cx, cy, cx + cluster_w, cy + cluster_h), radius=10, fill=card_bg, outline=blend_color(BG, color, 0.2), width=1)

    # Left accent stripe
    draw.rectangle([cx + 1, cy + 10, cx + 6, cy + cluster_h - 10], fill=color)

    # Colored dot + title
    draw.ellipse([cx + 18, cy + 14, cx + 30, cy + 26], fill=color)
    draw.text((cx + 38, cy + 10), title, fill=color, font=fnt_cluster_title)

    # Bullets
    by = cy + 48
    for bullet in bullets:
        draw.text((cx + 24, by), "→", fill=color, font=fnt_cluster_bullet)
        draw.text((cx + 44, by), bullet, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_cluster_bullet)
        by += 34

y += 2 * (cluster_h + 15) + 20

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# KEY TAKEAWAYS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
draw.text((MARGIN, y), "▸  KEY TAKEAWAYS", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_section)
y += 55

fnt_take_num = mono_font(28, "Bold")
fnt_take_title = font(24, "Bold")
fnt_take_body = font(20, "Regular")

for i, (title, body, color) in enumerate(TAKEAWAYS):
    num_str = str(i + 1)
    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.06)

    # Full-width card
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + CONTENT_W, y + 80), radius=10, fill=card_bg, outline=blend_color(BG, color, 0.2), width=1)

    draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 1, y + 10, MARGIN + 6, y + 70], fill=color)

    # Number badge
    badge_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.2)

    draw.text((MARGIN + 26, y + 22), num_str, fill=color, font=fnt_take_num)

    # Title
    draw.text((MARGIN + 75, y + 14), title, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_take_title)

    # Body
    draw.text((MARGIN + 75, y + 46), body, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_take_body)

    y += 95

y += 15

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, H - 65, W, H], fill=TITLE_BG)
draw.line([0, H - 65, W, H - 65], fill=BORDER, width=1)

fnt_footer = font(19, "Regular")
draw.text((MARGIN, H - 48), "Data: star-history.com  ·  Week of April 9–15, 2026  ·  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=fnt_footer)

# Category legend in footer

legend_x = W - MARGIN
for label, color in reversed(legend_items):
    lw = text_width(draw, label, fnt_footer_legend)
    legend_x -= lw + 26
    draw.rectangle([legend_x, H - 44, legend_x + 14, H - 30], fill=color)
    draw.text((legend_x + 20, H - 48), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_footer_legend)
    legend_x -= 18

# ── Save ──
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
img.save(OUT, "PNG", optimize=True)
print(f"Poster saved to {OUT} ({W}x{H}px)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster for social media."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──
BG = "#0D1117"
CARD = "#161B22"
CARD_ALT = "#1C2128"
BORDER = "#30363D"
TEXT_PRIMARY = "#E6EDF3"

NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def symbol_font(size):
    """Font that reliably renders Unicode symbols."""
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1:
        r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def text_width(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

def text_height(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[3] - bbox[1], 1)

def draw_glow_rect(img, xy, color, blur_radius=20, alpha=0.3):
    """Draw a soft glow behind an area."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    glow = Image.new("RGB", (x1 - x0 + blur_radius*4, y1 - y0 + blur_radius*4), (0, 0, 0))
    glow_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    r, g, b = hex_to_rgb(color)
    glow_draw.rectangle([blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
                         blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0],
                        fill=(r, g, b))
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=blur_radius))
    glow.putalpha(int(255 * alpha))
    img.paste(Image.alpha_composite(
        Image.new("RGBA", glow.size, (0, 0, 0, 0)),
        glow.convert("RGBA")
    ).convert("RGB").crop((
        blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
        blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0
    )), (x0, y0))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster for social media."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──
BG = "#0D1117"
CARD = "#161B22"
CARD_ALT = "#1C2128"
BORDER = "#30363D"
TEXT_PRIMARY = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE = "#3B82F6"
AMBER = "#F59E0B"
GREEN = "#10B981"
PURPLE = "#8B5CF6"
RED = "#F43F5E"
CYAN = "#06B6D4"
TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def symbol_font(size):
    """Font that reliably renders Unicode symbols."""
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",            "+9,715",  "agent"),
    (2,  "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills",  "+4,917",  "utility"),
    (3,  "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman",                "+4,407",  "utility"),
    (4,  "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace",                  "+3,524",  "utility"),
    (5,  "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",          "+3,246",  "design"),
    (6,  "▲", "microsoft/markitdown",                 "+3,048",  "utility"),
    (7,  "▼", "safishamsi/graphify",                  "+2,763",  "design"),
    (8,  "▲", "obra/superpowers",                     "+2,180",  "claude"),
    (9,  "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "+2,151","claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",      "+1,978",  "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",                "+1,828",  "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                  "+1,788",  "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                   "+1,506",  "utility"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                   "+1,286",  "agent"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code",               "+1,285",  "claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw",                    "+1,268",  "claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                       "+1,266",  "utility"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills",              "+1,195",  "agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk",                           "+1,098",  "utility"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                      "+1,012",  "utility"),
]

CATEGORY_COLORS = {
    "agent":  BLUE,
    "claude": AMBER,
    "design": PURPLE,
    "utility": GREEN,
}

CATEGORY_LABELS = {
    "agent":  "Agent",
    "claude": "Claude",
    "design": "Design",
    "utility": "Utility",
}

METRICS = [
    ("~48k", "Total Stars\nThis Week", BLUE),
    ("10", "Repos Above\n2k Stars", GREEN),
    ("5", "Claude-Related\nin Top 20", AMBER),
    ("+9,715", "hermes-agent\nWeekly Gain", RED),
]

TAKEAWAYS = [
    ("Agent-first development is surging", "hermes-agent's ~10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry", BLUE),
    ("Claude Code ecosystem is expanding fast", "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product", AMBER),
    ("Utility & infrastructure tools show sustained growth", "Foundational packages like markitdown attract steady interest", GREEN),
]

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1:
        r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def text_width(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

def text_height(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[3] - bbox[1], 1)

def draw_glow_rect(img, xy, color, blur_radius=20, alpha=0.3):
    """Draw a soft glow behind an area."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    glow = Image.new("RGB", (x1 - x0 + blur_radius*4, y1 - y0 + blur_radius*4), (0, 0, 0))
    glow_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    r, g, b = hex_to_rgb(color)
    glow_draw.rectangle([blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
                         blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0],
                        fill=(r, g, b))
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=blur_radius))
    glow.putalpha(int(255 * alpha))
    img.paste(Image.alpha_composite(
        Image.new("RGBA", glow.size, (0, 0, 0, 0)),
        glow.convert("RGBA")
    ).convert("RGB").crop((
        blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
        blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0
    )), (x0, y0))


# ── Build poster ──
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

MARGIN = 80
CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
y = 0

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE BAR
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
title_h = 300
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, title_h], fill=TITLE_BG)

# Gradient accent strip at top (3-color band)
band_h = 8
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W // 3, band_h], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([W // 3, 0, 2 * W // 3, band_h], fill=AMBER)
draw.rectangle([2 * W // 3, 0, W, band_h], fill=GREEN)

# Divider line
draw.rectangle([0, title_h - 2, W, title_h], fill=BORDER)

# Star icon using DejaVu (reliable Unicode rendering)
sym_fnt = symbol_font(68)
draw.text((MARGIN, 65), "⭐", fill=AMBER, font=sym_fnt)

# Title text
title_x = MARGIN + 100
fnt_title = font(76, "Black", display=True)
draw.text((title_x, 48), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_title)

# Subtitle
fnt_subtitle = font(32, "Medium")
draw.text((title_x, 148), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_subtitle)

# Date badge (right side)
fnt_date = font(26, "Medium")
date_text = "Apr 9 - 15, 2026"
dw = text_width(draw, date_text, fnt_date)
date_x = W - MARGIN - dw - 44
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (date_x, 65, date_x + dw + 44, 115), radius=10, fill=CARD, outline=BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((date_x + 22, 75), date_text, fill=AMBER, font=fnt_date)

# Source line
fnt_src = font(22, "Regular")
draw.text((title_x, 205), "Source: star-history.com  |  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=fnt_src)

y = title_h + 35

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# STATS BANNER (4 metric cards)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
stat_h = 220
stat_gap = 12
stat_w = (CONTENT_W - 3 * stat_gap) // 4

fnt_stat_num = mono_font(72, "Bold")
fnt_stat_label = font(22, "Medium")

for i, (num, label, color) in enumerate(METRICS):
    sx = MARGIN + i * (stat_w + stat_gap)
    sy = y

    # Card with tinted background
    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.08)
    card_border = blend_color(BG, color, 0.3)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (sx, sy, sx + stat_w, sy + stat_h), radius=14, fill=card_bg, outline=card_border, width=2)

    # Top accent bar inside card
    draw.rectangle([sx + 14, sy + 4, sx + stat_w - 14, sy + 8], fill=color)

    # Big number
    nw = text_width(draw, num, fnt_stat_num)
    draw.text((sx + (stat_w - nw) // 2, sy + 32), num, fill=color, font=fnt_stat_num)

    # Label (multiline)
    lines = label.split("\n")
    ly = sy + 130
    for line in lines:
        lw = text_width(draw, line, fnt_stat_label)
        draw.text((sx + (stat_w - lw) // 2, ly), line, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_stat_label)
        ly += 30

y += stat_h + 35

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION HEADER: FULL RANKING TABLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
fnt_section = font(36, "Bold", display=True)
draw.text((MARGIN, y), "FULL WEEKLY TOP 20 RANKING", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_section)

# Decorative line under section header
line_y = y + 48
draw.rectangle([MARGIN, line_y, MARGIN + 200, line_y + 4], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 200, line_y, MARGIN + 280, line_y + 4], fill=AMBER)
draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 280, line_y, MARGIN + 320, line_y + 4], fill=GREEN)

# Category legend (right of section header)
fnt_legend = font(20, "Bold")
legend_items = [("Agent", BLUE), ("Claude Code", AMBER), ("Design", PURPLE), ("Utility", GREEN)]
lx = W - MARGIN
for label, color in reversed(legend_items):
    lw = text_width(draw, label, fnt_legend)
    lx -= lw + 30
    draw.rectangle([lx, y + 8, lx + 16, y + 24], fill=color)
    draw.text((lx + 22, y + 5), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_legend)
    lx -= 18

y += 65

# ── Table layout ──
table_x = MARGIN
table_w = CONTENT_W
row_h = 62
header_h = 48

fnt_header = font(21, "Bold")
fnt_rank = mono_font(28, "Bold")
fnt_rank_big = mono_font(34, "Bold")
fnt_repo = font(23, "SemiBold")
fnt_stars = mono_font(26, "Bold")
fnt_trend = symbol_font(22)
fnt_tag = font(16, "Bold")
fnt_new = font(15, "Bold")

# Column widths
col_rank_w = 65
col_trend_w = 50
col_cat_w = 88
col_stars_w = 170
col_repo_w = table_w - col_rank_w - col_trend_w - col_cat_w - col_stars_w

col_rank_x = table_x
col_trend_x = col_rank_x + col_rank_w
col_repo_x = col_trend_x + col_trend_w
col_cat_x = col_repo_x + col_repo_w
col_stars_x = col_cat_x + col_cat_w

# Header row
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (table_x, y, table_x + table_w, y + header_h), radius=8, fill="#1A2332", outline=BORDER, width=1)
header_cols = [
    (col_rank_x + 10, "#"),
    (col_repo_x + 10, "REPOSITORY"),
    (col_cat_x + 8, "CATEGORY"),
    (col_stars_x + 10, "WEEKLY STARS"),
]
for hx, htext in header_cols:
    draw.text((hx, y + 11), htext, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_header)
y += header_h + 2

# Data rows
for rank, trend, repo, stars, cat in RANKINGS:
    row_y = y
    cat_color = CATEGORY_COLORS.get(cat, TEXT_DIM)
    cat_label = CATEGORY_LABELS.get(cat, "")

    # Row background
    if rank == 1:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, GREEN, 0.14)
    elif rank == 2:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, BLUE, 0.08)
    elif rank == 3:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, AMBER, 0.08)
    elif rank % 2 == 1:
        bg_color = CARD
    else:
        bg_color = CARD_ALT

    draw.rectangle([table_x, row_y, table_x + table_w, row_y + row_h], fill=bg_color)

    # Left accent bar for top 3
    if rank <= 3:
        accent = {1: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 3: AMBER}[rank]
        draw.rectangle([table_x, row_y, table_x + 5, row_y + row_h], fill=accent)

    # Bottom border
    draw.line([table_x, row_y + row_h - 1, table_x + table_w, row_y + row_h - 1], fill=BORDER, width=1)

    # Rank number (larger for top 3)
    rank_color = {1: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 3: AMBER}.get(rank, TEXT_DIM)
    rnk_fnt = fnt_rank_big if rank <= 3 else fnt_rank
    rnk_offset = 12 if rank <= 3 else 15
    draw.text((col_rank_x + 18, row_y + rnk_offset), f"{rank}", fill=rank_color, font=rnk_fnt)

    # #1 crown indicator
    if rank == 1:
        draw.text((col_rank_x + 2, row_y + 2), "♛", fill=GREEN, font=symbol_font(16))  # Queen crown

    # Trend indicator
    trend_x = col_trend_x + 8
    if trend == "▲":  # ▲
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 18), "▲", fill=GREEN, font=fnt_trend)
    elif trend == "▼":  # ▼
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 18), "▼", fill=RED, font=fnt_trend)
    elif trend == "N":
        draw_rounded_rect(draw, (trend_x - 2, row_y + 20, trend_x + 40, row_y + 40), radius=4, fill=blend_color(BG, CYAN, 0.2), outline=CYAN, width=1)
        draw.text((trend_x + 2, row_y + 20), "NEW", fill=CYAN, font=fnt_new)

    # Repository name (smart truncation)
    repo_display = repo
    rw = text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo)
    max_repo_w = col_repo_w - 20
    if rw > max_repo_w:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        owner = parts[0]
        name = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        # Try shortening owner
        for cut_len in range(len(owner)-1, 2, -1):
            test = owner[:cut_len] + ".. /" + name
            if text_width(draw, test, fnt_repo) <= max_repo_w:
                repo_display = test
                break
        else:
            # Still too long, truncate the full name
            while text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo) > max_repo_w and len(repo_display) > 8:

y += 65

clusters = [
    ("Agent Frameworks", BLUE, [
        "hermes-agent dominates with +9,715 stars",

    ]),
    ("Claude Code Ecosystem", AMBER, [
        "5 repos in Top 20 (25% of leaderboard)",

        "From best-practice guides to CLI wrappers",
    ]),
    ("Design & Visualization", PURPLE, [
        "awesome-design-md at #5 with +3,246",
        "graphify converts data to visual graphs",
        "AI-assisted design gaining traction",
    ]),
    ("Developer Utilities", GREEN, [
        "markitdown leads with +3,048 stars",
        "Foundational tools show steady growth",
        "Document-to-Markdown pipeline is hot",
    ]),
]

fnt_cluster_title = font(24, "Bold")
fnt_cluster_bullet = font(20, "Regular")
sym_fnt_sm = symbol_font(20)

for i, (title, color, bullets) in enumerate(clusters):
    cx = MARGIN + (i % 2) * (cluster_w + 20)
    cy = y + (i // 2) * (cluster_h + 15)

    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.06)
    card_border = blend_color(BG, color, 0.25)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (cx, cy, cx + cluster_w, cy + cluster_h), radius=10, fill=card_bg, outline=card_border, width=1)

    # Left accent stripe
    draw.rectangle([cx + 1, cy + 10, cx + 6, cy + cluster_h - 10], fill=color)

    # Colored dot + title
    draw.ellipse([cx + 18, cy + 14, cx + 32, cy + 28], fill=color)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 10), title, fill=color, font=fnt_cluster_title)

    # Bullets with arrow

    for bullet in bullets:
        draw.text((cx + 24, by), "→", fill=color, font=sym_fnt_sm)  # →
        draw.text((cx + 46, by), bullet, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_cluster_bullet)
        by += 36

y += 2 * (cluster_h + 15) + 25

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

    # Left accent

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster for social media."""

import os

W, H = 3000, 4500

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──

TEXT_PRIMARY = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE = "#3B82F6"
AMBER = "#F59E0B"

TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def symbol_font(size):
    """Font that reliably renders Unicode symbols."""
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",            "+9,715",  "agent"),

]

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1:
        r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def text_width(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

def text_height(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[3] - bbox[1], 1)

def draw_glow_rect(img, xy, color, blur_radius=20, alpha=0.3):
    """Draw a soft glow behind an area."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    glow = Image.new("RGB", (x1 - x0 + blur_radius*4, y1 - y0 + blur_radius*4), (0, 0, 0))
    glow_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    r, g, b = hex_to_rgb(color)
    glow_draw.rectangle([blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
                         blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0],
                        fill=(r, g, b))
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=blur_radius))
    glow.putalpha(int(255 * alpha))
    img.paste(Image.alpha_composite(
        Image.new("RGBA", glow.size, (0, 0, 0, 0)),
        glow.convert("RGBA")
    ).convert("RGB").crop((
        blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
        blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0
    )), (x0, y0))


# ── Build poster ──
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster for social media."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──
BG = "#0D1117"
CARD = "#161B22"

BORDER = "#30363D"
TEXT_PRIMARY = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE = "#3B82F6"
AMBER = "#F59E0B"
GREEN = "#10B981"
PURPLE = "#8B5CF6"
RED = "#F43F5E"
CYAN = "#06B6D4"
TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def symbol_font(size):
    """Font that reliably renders Unicode symbols."""
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [

    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills",              "+1,195",  "agent"),

    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                      "+1,012",  "utility"),
]

    "utility": GREEN,
}

    "design": "Design",
    "utility": "Utility",
}

]

    ("Agent-first development is surging", "hermes-agent's ~10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry", BLUE),
    ("Claude Code ecosystem is expanding fast", "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product", AMBER),
    ("Utility & infrastructure tools show sustained growth", "Foundational packages like markitdown attract steady interest", GREEN),
]

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1:
        r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def text_width(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

def text_height(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[3] - bbox[1], 1)

def draw_glow_rect(img, xy, color, blur_radius=20, alpha=0.3):
    """Draw a soft glow behind an area."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    glow = Image.new("RGB", (x1 - x0 + blur_radius*4, y1 - y0 + blur_radius*4), (0, 0, 0))
    glow_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    r, g, b = hex_to_rgb(color)
    glow_draw.rectangle([blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
                         blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0],
                        fill=(r, g, b))
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=blur_radius))
    glow.putalpha(int(255 * alpha))
    img.paste(Image.alpha_composite(
        Image.new("RGBA", glow.size, (0, 0, 0, 0)),
        glow.convert("RGBA")
    ).convert("RGB").crop((
        blur_radius*2, blur_radius*2,
        blur_radius*2 + x1-x0, blur_radius*2 + y1-y0
    )), (x0, y0))


# ── Build poster ──

draw.rectangle([W // 3, 0, 2 * W // 3, band_h], fill=AMBER)
draw.rectangle([2 * W // 3, 0, W, band_h], fill=GREEN)

# Divider line
draw.rectangle([0, title_h - 2, W, title_h], fill=BORDER)

# Star icon using DejaVu (reliable Unicode rendering)
sym_fnt = symbol_font(68)

# Title text
title_x = MARGIN + 100
fnt_title = font(76, "Black", display=True)

# Subtitle

# Date badge (right side)

dw = text_width(draw, date_text, fnt_date)
date_x = W - MARGIN - dw - 44
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (date_x, 65, date_x + dw + 44, 115), radius=10, fill=CARD, outline=BORDER, width=2)
draw.text((date_x + 22, 75), date_text, fill=AMBER, font=fnt_date)

# Source line
fnt_src = font(22, "Regular")
draw.text((title_x, 205), "Source: star-history.com  |  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=fnt_src)

y = title_h + 35

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

stat_gap = 12
stat_w = (CONTENT_W - 3 * stat_gap) // 4

fnt_stat_num = mono_font(72, "Bold")
fnt_stat_label = font(22, "Medium")

for i, (num, label, color) in enumerate(METRICS):
    sx = MARGIN + i * (stat_w + stat_gap)
    sy = y

    # Card with tinted background
    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.08)
    card_border = blend_color(BG, color, 0.3)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (sx, sy, sx + stat_w, sy + stat_h), radius=14, fill=card_bg, outline=card_border, width=2)

    # Top accent bar inside card
    draw.rectangle([sx + 14, sy + 4, sx + stat_w - 14, sy + 8], fill=color)

    # Big number
    nw = text_width(draw, num, fnt_stat_num)
    draw.text((sx + (stat_w - nw) // 2, sy + 32), num, fill=color, font=fnt_stat_num)

    # Label (multiline)
    lines = label.split("\n")
    ly = sy + 130
    for line in lines:
        lw = text_width(draw, line, fnt_stat_label)
        draw.text((sx + (stat_w - lw) // 2, ly), line, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_stat_label)
        ly += 30

y += stat_h + 35

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
fnt_section = font(36, "Bold", display=True)
draw.text((MARGIN, y), "FULL WEEKLY TOP 20 RANKING", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_section)

# Decorative line under section header
line_y = y + 48
draw.rectangle([MARGIN, line_y, MARGIN + 200, line_y + 4], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 200, line_y, MARGIN + 280, line_y + 4], fill=AMBER)
draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 280, line_y, MARGIN + 320, line_y + 4], fill=GREEN)

# Category legend (right of section header)
fnt_legend = font(20, "Bold")
legend_items = [("Agent", BLUE), ("Claude Code", AMBER), ("Design", PURPLE), ("Utility", GREEN)]
lx = W - MARGIN
for label, color in reversed(legend_items):
    lw = text_width(draw, label, fnt_legend)
    lx -= lw + 30
    draw.rectangle([lx, y + 8, lx + 16, y + 24], fill=color)
    draw.text((lx + 22, y + 5), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_legend)
    lx -= 18

y += 65

# ── Table layout ──
table_x = MARGIN
table_w = CONTENT_W
row_h = 62
header_h = 48

fnt_header = font(21, "Bold")
fnt_rank = mono_font(28, "Bold")
fnt_rank_big = mono_font(34, "Bold")
fnt_repo = font(23, "SemiBold")
fnt_stars = mono_font(26, "Bold")
fnt_trend = symbol_font(22)
fnt_tag = font(16, "Bold")
fnt_new = font(15, "Bold")

# Column widths
col_rank_w = 65
col_trend_w = 50
col_cat_w = 88
col_stars_w = 170
col_repo_w = table_w - col_rank_w - col_trend_w - col_cat_w - col_stars_w

col_rank_x = table_x
col_trend_x = col_rank_x + col_rank_w
col_repo_x = col_trend_x + col_trend_w
col_cat_x = col_repo_x + col_repo_w
col_stars_x = col_cat_x + col_cat_w

# Header row
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (table_x, y, table_x + table_w, y + header_h), radius=8, fill="#1A2332", outline=BORDER, width=1)
header_cols = [
    (col_rank_x + 10, "#"),
    (col_repo_x + 10, "REPOSITORY"),
    (col_cat_x + 8, "CATEGORY"),
    (col_stars_x + 10, "WEEKLY STARS"),
]
for hx, htext in header_cols:
    draw.text((hx, y + 11), htext, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_header)
y += header_h + 2

# Data rows
for rank, trend, repo, stars, cat in RANKINGS:
    row_y = y
    cat_color = CATEGORY_COLORS.get(cat, TEXT_DIM)
    cat_label = CATEGORY_LABELS.get(cat, "")

    # Row background
    if rank == 1:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, GREEN, 0.14)
    elif rank == 2:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, BLUE, 0.08)
    elif rank == 3:
        bg_color = blend_color(BG, AMBER, 0.08)
    elif rank % 2 == 1:
        bg_color = CARD
    else:
        bg_color = CARD_ALT

    draw.rectangle([table_x, row_y, table_x + table_w, row_y + row_h], fill=bg_color)

    # Left accent bar for top 3
    if rank <= 3:
        accent = {1: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 3: AMBER}[rank]
        draw.rectangle([table_x, row_y, table_x + 5, row_y + row_h], fill=accent)

    # Bottom border
    draw.line([table_x, row_y + row_h - 1, table_x + table_w, row_y + row_h - 1], fill=BORDER, width=1)

    # Rank number (larger for top 3)
    rank_color = {1: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 3: AMBER}.get(rank, TEXT_DIM)
    rnk_fnt = fnt_rank_big if rank <= 3 else fnt_rank
    rnk_offset = 12 if rank <= 3 else 15
    draw.text((col_rank_x + 18, row_y + rnk_offset), f"{rank}", fill=rank_color, font=rnk_fnt)

    # #1 crown indicator
    if rank == 1:
        draw.text((col_rank_x + 2, row_y + 2), "♛", fill=GREEN, font=symbol_font(16))  # Queen crown

    trend_x = col_trend_x + 8
    if trend == "▲":  # ▲
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 18), "▲", fill=GREEN, font=fnt_trend)
    elif trend == "▼":  # ▼
        draw.text((trend_x, row_y + 18), "▼", fill=RED, font=fnt_trend)
    elif trend == "N":
        draw_rounded_rect(draw, (trend_x - 2, row_y + 20, trend_x + 40, row_y + 40), radius=4, fill=blend_color(BG, CYAN, 0.2), outline=CYAN, width=1)
        draw.text((trend_x + 2, row_y + 20), "NEW", fill=CYAN, font=fnt_new)

    # Repository name (smart truncation)
    repo_display = repo
    rw = text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo)
    max_repo_w = col_repo_w - 20
    if rw > max_repo_w:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        owner = parts[0]
        name = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        # Try shortening owner
        for cut_len in range(len(owner)-1, 2, -1):
            test = owner[:cut_len] + ".. /" + name
            if text_width(draw, test, fnt_repo) <= max_repo_w:
                repo_display = test
                break
        else:
            # Still too long, truncate the full name
            while text_width(draw, repo_display, fnt_repo) > max_repo_w and len(repo_display) > 8:
                repo_display = repo_display[:-4] + "..."
    draw.text((col_repo_x + 10, row_y + 17), repo_display, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_repo)

    # Category tag

    tag_bg = blend_color(BG, cat_color, 0.18)
    tag_border = blend_color(BG, cat_color, 0.5)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (col_cat_x, tag_y, col_cat_x + tlw, tag_y + 24), radius=5, fill=tag_bg, outline=tag_border, width=1)

draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 230, line_y, MARGIN + 260, line_y + 4], fill=GREEN)

cluster_h = 180

    ("Design & Visualization", PURPLE, [
        "awesome-design-md at #5 with +3,246",

    ]),
    ("Developer Utilities", GREEN, [
        "markitdown leads with +3,048 stars",
        "Foundational tools show steady growth",
        "Document-to-Markdown pipeline is hot",
    ]),
]

fnt_cluster_title = font(24, "Bold")
fnt_cluster_bullet = font(20, "Regular")
sym_fnt_sm = symbol_font(20)

for i, (title, color, bullets) in enumerate(clusters):
    cx = MARGIN + (i % 2) * (cluster_w + 20)
    cy = y + (i // 2) * (cluster_h + 15)

    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.06)
    card_border = blend_color(BG, color, 0.25)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (cx, cy, cx + cluster_w, cy + cluster_h), radius=10, fill=card_bg, outline=card_border, width=1)

    # Left accent stripe
    draw.rectangle([cx + 1, cy + 10, cx + 6, cy + cluster_h - 10], fill=color)

    # Colored dot + title
    draw.ellipse([cx + 18, cy + 14, cx + 32, cy + 28], fill=color)
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 10), title, fill=color, font=fnt_cluster_title)

y += 2 * (cluster_h + 15) + 25

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
draw.text((MARGIN, y), "KEY TAKEAWAYS", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=fnt_section)

line_y = y + 48
draw.rectangle([MARGIN, line_y, MARGIN + 180, line_y + 4], fill=GREEN)
draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 180, line_y, MARGIN + 260, line_y + 4], fill=AMBER)
draw.rectangle([MARGIN + 260, line_y, MARGIN + 300, line_y + 4], fill=BLUE)

for i, (title, body, color) in enumerate(TAKEAWAYS):

img.save(OUT, "PNG", optimize=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster - final version."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──
BG = "#0D1117"
CARD = "#161B22"
CARD_ALT = "#1C2128"
BORDER = "#30363D"
TEXT_PRIMARY = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE = "#3B82F6"
AMBER = "#F59E0B"
GREEN = "#10B981"
PURPLE = "#8B5CF6"
RED = "#F43F5E"
CYAN = "#06B6D4"
TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def sym_font(size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",            "+9,715",  "agent"),

    (4,  "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace",                  "+3,524",  "utility"),
    (5,  "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",          "+3,246",  "design"),
    (6,  "▲", "microsoft/markitdown",                 "+3,048",  "utility"),
    (7,  "▼", "safishamsi/graphify",                  "+2,763",  "design"),
    (8,  "▲", "obra/superpowers",                     "+2,180",  "claude"),
    (9,  "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "+2,151","claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",      "+1,978",  "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",                "+1,828",  "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                  "+1,788",  "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                   "+1,506",  "utility"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                   "+1,286",  "agent"),

def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1: r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster - final version."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os, math

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──
BG = "#0D1117"

TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE = "#3B82F6"
AMBER = "#F59E0B"
GREEN = "#10B981"
PURPLE = "#8B5CF6"
RED = "#F43F5E"
CYAN = "#06B6D4"
TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def sym_font(size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Data ──

    ("Agent-first development is surging", "hermes-agent's ~10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry", BLUE),

]

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1: r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def sym_font(size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1: r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster - final version."""

W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors (dark mode, GitHub-inspired) ──

TEXT_PRIMARY = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE = "#3B82F6"
AMBER = "#F59E0B"
GREEN = "#10B981"

# ── Fonts ──
INTER = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{weight}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{weight}.otf"
NOTO_MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{weight}.ttf"
DEJAVU = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def font(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    path = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(weight=weight)
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU_BOLD if "Bold" in weight else DEJAVU, size)
        except:
            return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight="Bold" if "Bold" in weight else "Regular"), size)

def mono_font(size, weight="Regular"):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(NOTO_MONO.format(weight=weight), size)
    except:
        return font(size, weight)

def sym_font(size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(DEJAVU, size)
    except:
        return font(size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",            "+9,715",  "agent"),

]

# ── Helpers ──
def hex_to_rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend_color(base_hex, overlay_hex, alpha):
    br, bg_, bb = hex_to_rgb(base_hex)
    or_, og, ob = hex_to_rgb(overlay_hex)
    r = int(br * (1 - alpha) + or_ * alpha)
    g = int(bg_ * (1 - alpha) + og * alpha)
    b = int(bb * (1 - alpha) + ob * alpha)
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(radius, max((x1 - x0) // 2, 1), max((y1 - y0) // 2, 1))
    if r < 1: r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return max(bbox[2] - bbox[0], 1)

# ── Build poster ──
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot grid background pattern
dot_color = "#141921"

MARGIN = 80
CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
y = 0

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

title_h = 300

# 3-color gradient accent strip at top
band_h = 8

draw.rectangle([2 * W // 3, 0, W, band_h], fill=GREEN)

draw.rectangle([0, title_h - 2, W, title_h], fill=BORDER)

# Star symbol
draw.text((MARGIN, 65), "*", fill=AMBER, font=font(80, "Black", display=True))

# Title
title_x = MARGIN + 80
draw.text((title_x, 48), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=font(76, "Black", display=True))

# Subtitle with accent color
fnt_sub = font(32, "Medium")
draw.text((title_x, 148), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=fnt_sub)

# Date badge
fnt_date = font(26, "Medium")
date_text = "Apr 9 - 15, 2026"
dw = tw(draw, date_text, fnt_date)
date_x = W - MARGIN - dw - 44
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (date_x, 60, date_x + dw + 44, 112), radius=10, fill=CARD, outline=AMBER, width=2)
draw.text((date_x + 22, 72), date_text, fill=AMBER, font=fnt_date)

# Source line
draw.text((title_x, 205), "Source: star-history.com  |  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=font(22))

y = title_h + 35

# ═══════════════════════════════════════

for i, (num, label, color) in enumerate(METRICS):

    card_bg = blend_color(BG, color, 0.08)

# Table layout

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster — final production version."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors ──
BG = "#0D1117"
CARD = "#161B22"
CARD_ALT = "#1C2128"
BORDER = "#30363D"
TEXT_PRI = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SEC = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE   = "#3B82F6"
AMBER  = "#F59E0B"
GREEN  = "#10B981"
PURPLE = "#8B5CF6"
RED    = "#F43F5E"
CYAN   = "#06B6D4"
TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Font paths ──
INTER      = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{w}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{w}.otf"
NOTO_MONO  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{w}.ttf"
DEJAVU     = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_B   = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def _tf(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def fnt(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    p = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(w=weight)
    return _tf(p, size)

def mono(size, weight="Bold"):
    return _tf(NOTO_MONO.format(w=weight), size)

def sym(size, bold=False):
    return _tf(DEJAVU_B if bold else DEJAVU, size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",              "+9,715",  "agent"),
    (2,  "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills",    "+4,917",  "utility"),
    (3,  "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman",                  "+4,407",  "utility"),
    (4,  "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace",                    "+3,524",  "utility"),
    (5,  "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",            "+3,246",  "design"),
    (6,  "▲", "microsoft/markitdown",                   "+3,048",  "utility"),
    (7,  "▼", "safishamsi/graphify",                    "+2,763",  "design"),
    (8,  "▲", "obra/superpowers",                       "+2,180",  "claude"),
    (9,  "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "+2,151",  "claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",        "+1,978",  "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",                  "+1,828",  "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                    "+1,788",  "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                     "+1,506",  "utility"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                     "+1,286",  "agent"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code",                 "+1,285",  "claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw",                      "+1,268",  "claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                         "+1,266",  "utility"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills",                "+1,195",  "agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk",                             "+1,098",  "utility"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                        "+1,012",  "utility"),
]

CAT_CLR = {"agent": BLUE, "claude": AMBER, "design": PURPLE, "utility": GREEN}
CAT_LBL = {"agent": "Agent", "claude": "Claude", "design": "Design", "utility": "Utility"}

METRICS = [
    ("~48k",   "Total Stars\nThis Week",         BLUE),
    ("10",     "Repos Above\n2k Stars",           GREEN),
    ("5",      "Claude-Related\nin Top 20",       AMBER),
    ("+9,715", "hermes-agent\nWeekly Gain",       RED),
]

TAKEAWAYS = [
    ("Agent-first development is surging",          "hermes-agent's ~10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry",     BLUE),
    ("Claude Code ecosystem is expanding fast",      "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product",              AMBER),
    ("Utility & infrastructure tools show sustained growth", "Foundational packages like markitdown attract steady interest", GREEN),
]

# ── Helpers ──
def h2rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend(base, over, a):
    br, bg_, bb = h2rgb(base)
    r_, g_, b_ = h2rgb(over)
    return f"#{int(br*(1-a)+r_*a):02x}{int(bg_*(1-a)+g_*a):02x}{int(bb*(1-a)+b_*a):02x}"

def rrect(draw, xy, rad, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(rad, max((x1-x0)//2, 1), max((y1-y0)//2, 1))
    if r < 1: r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r,y1,x1-r,y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0,y0+r,x0,y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    return max(draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)[2] - draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)[0], 1)

def accent_line(draw, x, y, total_w, colors):
    """Draw a segmented accent line."""
    seg = total_w // len(colors)
    for i, c in enumerate(colors):
        draw.rectangle([x + i*seg, y, x + (i+1)*seg, y+4], fill=c)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# BUILD POSTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot grid background
dot_c = "#141921"
for dx in range(0, W, 40):
    for dy in range(0, H, 40):
        draw.point((dx, dy), fill=dot_c)

M = 80  # margin
CW = W - 2*M  # content width
y = 0

# ── TITLE BAR ──
TH = 300
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, TH], fill=TITLE_BG)
accent_line(draw, 0, 0, W, [BLUE, AMBER, GREEN])
draw.rectangle([0, TH-2, W, TH], fill=BORDER)

# Star icon (Unicode ★ via DejaVu)
draw.text((M, 58), "★", fill=AMBER, font=sym(72, bold=True))

# Title
tx = M + 95
draw.text((tx, 42), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRI, font=fnt(76, "Black", True))
draw.text((tx, 146), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth", fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fnt(32, "Medium"))

# Date badge
fnt_d = fnt(26, "Medium")
dt = "Apr 9 – 15, 2026"
dw_ = tw(draw, dt, fnt_d)
dx = W - M - dw_ - 44
rrect(draw, (dx, 58, dx+dw_+44, 112), 10, fill=CARD, outline=AMBER, width=2)
draw.text((dx+22, 70), dt, fill=AMBER, font=fnt_d)

draw.text((tx, 205), "Source: star-history.com  ·  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=fnt(22))

y = TH + 35

# ── STATS BANNER ──
SH = 220
SG = 12
SW = (CW - 3*SG) // 4

for i, (num, lbl, clr) in enumerate(METRICS):
    sx = M + i*(SW+SG)
    cb = blend(BG, clr, 0.08)
    cd = blend(BG, clr, 0.3)
    rrect(draw, (sx, y, sx+SW, y+SH), 14, fill=cb, outline=cd, width=2)
    draw.rectangle([sx+14, y+4, sx+SW-14, y+8], fill=clr)
    nw = tw(draw, num, mono(72))
    draw.text((sx+(SW-nw)//2, y+30), num, fill=clr, font=mono(72))
    lines = lbl.split("\n")
    ly = y + 128
    for ln in lines:
        lw = tw(draw, ln, fnt(22, "Medium"))
        draw.text((sx+(SW-lw)//2, ly), ln, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fnt(22, "Medium"))
        ly += 30

y += SH + 35

# ── RANKING TABLE ──
draw.text((M, y), "FULL WEEKLY TOP 20 RANKING", fill=TEXT_PRI, font=fnt(36, "Black", True))
accent_line(draw, M, y+48, 320, [BLUE, AMBER, GREEN])

# Legend (right)
lgd = [("Agent", BLUE), ("Claude Code", AMBER), ("Design", PURPLE), ("Utility", GREEN)]
fl = fnt(20, "Bold")
lx = W - M
for lb, c in reversed(lgd):
    lw = tw(draw, lb, fl)
    lx -= lw + 30
    draw.rectangle([lx, y+8, lx+16, y+24], fill=c)
    draw.text((lx+22, y+5), lb, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fl)
    lx -= 18
y += 65

# Table geometry
TX = M
TW = CW
HH = 48
RH = 62
RH_HERO = 74  # taller row for #1

# Column positions
c0 = TX           # rank
c1 = c0 + 65      # trend
c2 = c1 + 50      # repo
c3 = TX + TW - 88 - 170  # category
c4 = TX + TW - 170       # stars

# Header
rrect(draw, (TX, y, TX+TW, y+HH), 8, fill="#1A2332", outline=BORDER, width=1)
for hx, ht in [(c0+10,"#"),(c2+10,"REPOSITORY"),(c3+8,"CATEGORY"),(c4+10,"WEEKLY STARS")]:
    draw.text((hx, y+11), ht, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fnt(21, "Bold"))
y += HH + 2

# Data rows
for rk, tr, repo, stars, cat in RANKINGS:
    ry = y
    cc = CAT_CLR.get(cat, TEXT_DIM)
    cl = CAT_LBL.get(cat, "")
    hero = (rk == 1)
    rh = RH_HERO if hero else RH

    # Background
    if rk == 1:   bg = blend(BG, GREEN, 0.15)
    elif rk == 2: bg = blend(BG, BLUE, 0.08)
    elif rk == 3: bg = blend(BG, AMBER, 0.08)
    elif rk%2==1: bg = CARD
    else:         bg = CARD_ALT

    draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+TW, ry+rh], fill=bg)

    # Top-3 left accent
    if rk <= 3:
        ac = {1:GREEN, 2:BLUE, 3:AMBER}[rk]
        bw = 6 if hero else 4
        draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+bw, ry+rh], fill=ac)

    # #1 hero glow border
    if hero:
        for bw in [2, 1]:
            draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+TW, ry+bw], fill=GREEN)
            draw.rectangle([TX, ry+rh-bw, TX+TW, ry+rh], fill=GREEN)
            draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+bw, ry+rh], fill=GREEN)
            draw.rectangle([TX+TW-bw, ry, TX+TW, ry+rh], fill=GREEN)

    # Row separator
    draw.line([TX, ry+rh-1, TX+TW, ry+rh-1], fill=BORDER, width=1)

    # Rank

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster — final production version."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

# ── Dimensions ──
W, H = 3000, 4500
OUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Colors ──
BG = "#0D1117"
CARD = "#161B22"
CARD_ALT = "#1C2128"
BORDER = "#30363D"
TEXT_PRI = "#E6EDF3"
TEXT_SEC = "#8B949E"
TEXT_DIM = "#484F58"

BLUE   = "#3B82F6"
AMBER  = "#F59E0B"
GREEN  = "#10B981"
PURPLE = "#8B5CF6"
RED    = "#F43F5E"
CYAN   = "#06B6D4"
TITLE_BG = "#0A0F1A"

# ── Font paths ──
INTER      = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-{w}.otf"
INTER_DISP = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/InterDisplay-{w}.otf"
NOTO_MONO  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansMono-{w}.ttf"
DEJAVU     = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
DEJAVU_B   = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

def _tf(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def fnt(size, weight="Regular", display=False):
    p = (INTER_DISP if display else INTER).format(w=weight)
    return _tf(p, size)

def mono(size, weight="Bold"):
    return _tf(NOTO_MONO.format(w=weight), size)

def sym(size, bold=False):
    return _tf(DEJAVU_B if bold else DEJAVU, size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",              "+9,715",  "agent"),
    (2,  "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills",    "+4,917",  "utility"),

    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",        "+1,978",  "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",                  "+1,828",  "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                    "+1,788",  "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                     "+1,506",  "utility"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                     "+1,286",  "agent"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code",                 "+1,285",  "claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw",                      "+1,268",  "claude"),

    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                        "+1,012",  "utility"),

]

# ── Helpers ──
def h2rgb(h):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))

def blend(base, over, a):
    br, bg_, bb = h2rgb(base)
    r_, g_, b_ = h2rgb(over)
    return f"#{int(br*(1-a)+r_*a):02x}{int(bg_*(1-a)+g_*a):02x}{int(bb*(1-a)+b_*a):02x}"

def rrect(draw, xy, rad, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(rad, max((x1-x0)//2, 1), max((y1-y0)//2, 1))
    if r < 1: r = 1
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r,y1,x1-r,y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0,y0+r,x0,y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    return max(draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)[2] - draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)[0], 1)

def accent_line(draw, x, y, total_w, colors):
    """Draw a segmented accent line."""
    seg = total_w // len(colors)
    for i, c in enumerate(colors):
        draw.rectangle([x + i*seg, y, x + (i+1)*seg, y+4], fill=c)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# BUILD POSTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot grid background
dot_c = "#141921"
for dx in range(0, W, 40):
    for dy in range(0, H, 40):
        draw.point((dx, dy), fill=dot_c)

M = 80  # margin
CW = W - 2*M  # content width
y = 0

# ── TITLE BAR ──
TH = 300
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, TH], fill=TITLE_BG)
accent_line(draw, 0, 0, W, [BLUE, AMBER, GREEN])
draw.rectangle([0, TH-2, W, TH], fill=BORDER)

# Star icon (Unicode ★ via DejaVu)
draw.text((M, 58), "★", fill=AMBER, font=sym(72, bold=True))

# Title
tx = M + 95
draw.text((tx, 42), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRI, font=fnt(76, "Black", True))
draw.text((tx, 146), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth", fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fnt(32, "Medium"))

# Date badge
fnt_d = fnt(26, "Medium")
dt = "Apr 9 – 15, 2026"
dw_ = tw(draw, dt, fnt_d)
dx = W - M - dw_ - 44
rrect(draw, (dx, 58, dx+dw_+44, 112), 10, fill=CARD, outline=AMBER, width=2)
draw.text((dx+22, 70), dt, fill=AMBER, font=fnt_d)

draw.text((tx, 205), "Source: star-history.com  ·  Open-source coding AI repositories", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=fnt(22))

y = TH + 35

# ── STATS BANNER ──
SH = 220
SG = 12
SW = (CW - 3*SG) // 4

for i, (num, lbl, clr) in enumerate(METRICS):
    sx = M + i*(SW+SG)
    cb = blend(BG, clr, 0.08)
    cd = blend(BG, clr, 0.3)
    rrect(draw, (sx, y, sx+SW, y+SH), 14, fill=cb, outline=cd, width=2)
    draw.rectangle([sx+14, y+4, sx+SW-14, y+8], fill=clr)
    nw = tw(draw, num, mono(72))
    draw.text((sx+(SW-nw)//2, y+30), num, fill=clr, font=mono(72))
    lines = lbl.split("\n")
    ly = y + 128
    for ln in lines:
        lw = tw(draw, ln, fnt(22, "Medium"))
        draw.text((sx+(SW-lw)//2, ly), ln, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fnt(22, "Medium"))
        ly += 30

y += SH + 35

# ── RANKING TABLE ──
draw.text((M, y), "FULL WEEKLY TOP 20 RANKING", fill=TEXT_PRI, font=fnt(36, "Black", True))
accent_line(draw, M, y+48, 320, [BLUE, AMBER, GREEN])

# Legend (right)
lgd = [("Agent", BLUE), ("Claude Code", AMBER), ("Design", PURPLE), ("Utility", GREEN)]
fl = fnt(20, "Bold")
lx = W - M
for lb, c in reversed(lgd):
    lw = tw(draw, lb, fl)
    lx -= lw + 30
    draw.rectangle([lx, y+8, lx+16, y+24], fill=c)
    draw.text((lx+22, y+5), lb, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fl)
    lx -= 18
y += 65

# Table geometry
TX = M
TW = CW
HH = 48
RH = 62
RH_HERO = 74  # taller row for #1

# Column positions
c0 = TX           # rank
c1 = c0 + 65      # trend
c2 = c1 + 50      # repo
c3 = TX + TW - 88 - 170  # category
c4 = TX + TW - 170       # stars

# Header
rrect(draw, (TX, y, TX+TW, y+HH), 8, fill="#1A2332", outline=BORDER, width=1)
for hx, ht in [(c0+10,"#"),(c2+10,"REPOSITORY"),(c3+8,"CATEGORY"),(c4+10,"WEEKLY STARS")]:
    draw.text((hx, y+11), ht, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=fnt(21, "Bold"))
y += HH + 2

# Data rows
for rk, tr, repo, stars, cat in RANKINGS:
    ry = y
    cc = CAT_CLR.get(cat, TEXT_DIM)
    cl = CAT_LBL.get(cat, "")
    hero = (rk == 1)
    rh = RH_HERO if hero else RH

    # Background
    if rk == 1:   bg = blend(BG, GREEN, 0.15)
    elif rk == 2: bg = blend(BG, BLUE, 0.08)
    elif rk == 3: bg = blend(BG, AMBER, 0.08)
    elif rk%2==1: bg = CARD
    else:         bg = CARD_ALT

    draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+TW, ry+rh], fill=bg)

    # Top-3 left accent
    if rk <= 3:
        ac = {1:GREEN, 2:BLUE, 3:AMBER}[rk]
        bw = 6 if hero else 4
        draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+bw, ry+rh], fill=ac)

    # #1 hero glow border
    if hero:
        for bw in [2, 1]:
            draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+TW, ry+bw], fill=GREEN)
            draw.rectangle([TX, ry+rh-bw, TX+TW, ry+rh], fill=GREEN)
            draw.rectangle([TX, ry, TX+bw, ry+rh], fill=GREEN)
            draw.rectangle([TX+TW-bw, ry, TX+TW, ry+rh], fill=GREEN)

    # Row separator
    draw.line([TX, ry+rh-1, TX+TW, ry+rh-1], fill=BORDER, width=1)

    # Rank
    rc = {1:GREEN, 2:BLUE, 3:AMBER}.get(rk, TEXT_DIM)
    rf = mono(36 if hero else (30 if rk<=3 else 28))
    ro = 16 if hero else (12 if rk<=3 else 15)
    draw.text((c0+14, ry+ro), str(rk), fill=rc, font=rf)

    # #1 crown badge
    if hero:
        draw.text((c0+8, ry+1), "👑", fill=AMBER, font=sym(18))  # small crown

    # Trend
    tox = c1 + 8
    toy = ry + (22 if hero else 19)

    elif tr == "▼":

        draw.text((tox+2, toy), "NEW", fill=CYAN, font=fnt(15, "Bold"))

    # Repository name
    rf2 = fnt(26, "Bold") if hero else fnt(23, "SemiBold")
    rd = repo
    maxrw = c3 - c2 - 20
    if tw(draw, rd, rf2) > maxrw:
        parts = repo.split("/")
        ow = parts[0]
        nm = parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else ""
        for cl_ in range(len(ow)-1, 2, -1):
            test = ow[:cl_] + "../" + nm
            if tw(draw, test, rf2) <= maxrw:
                rd = test; break
        else:
            while tw(draw, rd, rf2) > maxrw and len(rd) > 8:
                rd = rd[:-4] + "..."
    rnc = GREEN if hero else TEXT_PRI
    draw.text((c2+10, ry+(20 if hero else 17)), rd, fill=rnc, font=rf2)

    # Category tag
    tag_h = 24
    tag_y = ry + (rh - tag_h)//2
    tlw_ = tw(draw, cl, fnt(16, "Bold")) + 16
    rrect(draw, (c3, tag_y, c3+tlw_, tag_y+tag_h), 5,

    draw.text((c3+8, tag_y+3), cl, fill=cc, font=fnt(16, "Bold"))

    # Stars
    sf = mono(32 if hero else 26)
    sc = GREEN if hero else (AMBER if rk<=5 else TEXT_PRI)
    sw_ = tw(draw, stars, sf)
    draw.text((c4+170-sw_-12, ry+(18 if hero else 16)), stars, fill=sc, font=sf)

    if rk <= 5:

    y += rh
